text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Still not good enough. Even I can tell. 
The feeling is completely off.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you practicing too, Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Spe-chan! That's right~ I'm getting a 
tad serious♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you practicing too, Spe-chan? Why 
don't we run together, then?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ~~...gh! W-With Maruzen-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm wicked happy~! I'll give it 
everything with my heart and soul!!

On this day, I came to a cafe with Sakura 
Chiyono O to hold a meeting over lunch.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Which menu item will you pick, Trainer? 
Oh, they have hot dogs too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! About the Fan Appreciation Day, I'm so 
terribly sorry...! I caused so much 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, how about some salad? We can 
have matching ones. "One carrot salad, 
coming right up!" ...Just kidding.
choice_data_list: Are you only going to eat salad?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aha~... yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, there are days where I just get 
tired of eating, for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My body feels heavy too... Fufu, maybe my 
body is sending me a signal that it's time 
to diet.
choice_data_list:
...Tired of eating, making your body feel 
heavy?

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she even turned down 
takoyaki on New Year's herself, saying she 
"wasn't hungry."

And that topic felt familiar, like 
something I had heard elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She could barely eat to begin with, and 
now her appetite's gone down even more. 
Her legs were feeling a bit heavy too, so 
I decided to have her take a break for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's a sign from my body. 
...Telling me that it's time to call it 
quits."

—It was just like what Tamamo Cross had 
said in her press conference.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but only a little bit, okay? Just a 
tiny little bit!

For an Umamusume, there comes a stage 
where her body and racing aptitude 
suddenly experience explosive growth.

Her awakening as a racing Umamusume. —The 
phenomenon known as the "Peak Period."

An Umamusume who has reached her Awakening 
begins to feel unprecedented potential 
within her own body.

"My body feels light, I don't tire out as 
easily no matter how much I run, my 
appetite has grown significantly compared 
to before..." and so forth.

And so, they train relentlessly to bring 
their abilities into full bloom, ready to 
take on the races.

However, on the other hand, if your body 
feels heavy, doesn't move as you want it 
to, or if you lose your appetite...

Past the peak, in the middle of a gradual 
decline. It is proof that we are heading 
toward the end—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, am I currently... 
already on the decline...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's only the spring of your Senior 
year, right? Saying you're past your peak 
already is just...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way......

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list:
...Shall we talk about this again another 
time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ………… ...The sunset is so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I seeee, the sunset, huh...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So~rry, Spe-chan! Can we do just one more? 
Just one more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Whew~... Yeees~... Of 
course~...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, sorry when you're already exhausted! 
I'll wrap this up in no time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Since I made a promise with her, I've 
made up my mind to give it my all."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ......Maruzen-san, I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...S-Surprisingly enough, it's a huge 
shock! I thought I was completely 
ordinary, but it turns out there might be 
something extraordinary about me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It turns out I might just be an Umamusume 
who matures early and has a short peak... 
............

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...You're so incredibly strong. So an 
ordinary girl like me has to work far 
harder than ordinary, or else...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To chase after your fleeing back. First, 
raise speed, then build stamina.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Watch your line, and push through to the 
end with pure grit—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, what if... my peak has already 
passed? What will I...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um, regarding our upcoming 
training...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
First, may I explain what I would like to 
request from you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Um, well, even if I am going 
downhill, I've only just started the 
descent, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking, if I work hard in 
training, maybe I can maintain something 
as close to my peak as possible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And besides, it's possible that she hasn't 
even passed her peak yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because it might be too early to judge 
based on these symptoms alone! Maybe it's 
just regular fatigue, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So... that's why...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now's the time to dig deep, wouldn't you 
say?! How about we boldly increase our 
practice sessions?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Th-Thank you so much! Then I'll do my 
very best!
choice_data_list:
Still, let's be extra careful about 
injuries, alright?

Still, let's be extra careful about 
injuries, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes, exactly. It'd be terrible if 
you got hurt. Especially during a time 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...U-Um, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep putting every ounce of energy 
into my training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, there's still... hope for me too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can become her rival... can't I?

Inside the room overlooking the sunset, 
Sakura Chiyo no O's voice resonated with 
unusual clarity...
